summary: The bioRxiv Table S1 DESeq2 results cover the registered 16-hour fasted versus ad libitum fed wild-type hypothalamus contrast at ZT16. Both author-concordance-v2 effect criteria pass across 16,906 of 16,909 registered genes. At FDR < 0.05, the authors called 929 genes and HypoExplorer called 793, with 789 shared.

manualReview.summary: Wild-type fasting effects agree across 16,906 paired genes
manualReview.note: The full FastingInWT sheet in bioRxiv Table S1 supplies DESeq2 effects and gene-wise statistics for the same tissue, genotype, feeding interval and time point as registered edgeR-QL. Across all paired effects, Pearson r is 0.991693 and Spearman rho is 0.999371. Signs agree for 16,575 of 16,906 nonzero pairs. Of 929 author FDR < 0.05 calls, 907 have registered rows and 789 are significant in both fits. All 793 registered calls have an evaluable author adjusted P. The exact-text-only join also passes both effect criteria. The direct comparison and original sources are retained in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE254155/codex-2026-11-21/.
reviewFlags: Four Excel date cells have competing March/Marc gene identifiers. Three registered symbols remain unpaired.
The source records identify libraries and feeding groups. They do not link each RNA library to an identified individual animal or specify pooling.
The numerical reference is the preprint workbook. The published manuscript confirms the contrast and 929 discoveries, but byte identity with the journal workbook remains unverified.

verificationReview.reason: The full preprint result pairs with 99.9823% of the registered output and passes both effect-concordance routes. The author DESeq2 and registered edgeR-QL fits differ in tested universe and FDR calls. The manuscript reports the same 929 wild-type discoveries recovered from the preprint.
verificationReview.nextStep: For full reproduction, obtain the journal workbook or its checksum, the original text identifiers for the four March date cells, the library-to-animal mapping and the authors’ exact DESeq2 model and filtering settings.

comparabilityReview.basis: Direct comparison of the full preprint FastingInWT worksheet with the registered GSE254155_DE.tsv. Every finite, uniquely identifiable shared effect enters the comparison in the published orientation.
comparabilityReview.reference: Levine et al., bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.01.29.577255v1, Supplemental Table 1 (DC2, media-2.xlsx), FastingInWT. The Science author manuscript, Figure 3D–F and the RNA sequencing methods confirm the contrast, test and discovery count.

cohort.note: The 20 control-genotype GEO libraries match every registered sample and both model arms. Each arm has ten male B6/J hypothalamus libraries at ZT16. The paper describes the same wild-type feeding groups. The author sheet contains summary statistics without library IDs, and the public RNA methods leave individual animal identity and pooling unspecified.

contrast.note: Wild-type whole hypothalamus at ZT16 after a 16-hour fast versus ad libitum feeding. The selected companion sheet explicitly labels its WT coefficient log2 fasting/AL. The registered groupcase coefficient uses fed as baseline. Orientation sign is +1.

features.note: 16,886 literal, case-sensitive symbols pair directly. A further 20 date cells have a unique month/day-to-symbol match in the entire 49,568-feature GEO annotation. Four cells labeled March 1 or March 2 have competing Marc and March symbols. Their worksheet row IDs keep them unpaired. Marc2, March1 and March2 are the three unpaired registered symbols. No effect, P value or FDR entered these assignments.

effects.note: Both estimators report log2 expression fold change for fasted relative to fed. Across all 16,906 pairs, Pearson r is 0.991693 and Spearman rho is 0.999371. Signs agree for 16,575 pairs (98.0421%). All paired effects are nonzero. The median absolute difference is 0.003491 log2 units, the maximum is 2.193716 and the registered-to-author RMS effect ratio is 0.980697. The literal-text-only sensitivity gives Pearson 0.991690 and Spearman 0.999371.

inference.note: The full tables give 929 DESeq2 and 793 edgeR-QL FDR < 0.05 calls, with 789 shared. Of 16,906 jointly finite adjusted-P pairs, 907 are author-positive and 793 are registered-positive. There are 118 author-only and four registered-only calls on those pairs. Another 22 author calls have no registered row. The 1,188 missing author adjusted P values occur outside the paired set. For raw P < 0.05, 2,511 author and 2,500 registered calls occur among paired genes, with 2,398 shared.

coverage.note: One registered contrast, full preprint results. The 16,906 pairs cover 99.9823% of 16,909 registered effects and 82.7792% of 20,423 source rows. A further 3,513 intact source symbols lie outside the registered table and four source identifiers remain ambiguous. Every paired gene has both raw P and adjusted P in both tables.

comparabilityReview.criteria: For a full reference, author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs and coverage of at least 90% of registered genes. Effects pass when Pearson and Spearman both reach 0.90, or when signs agree for at least 90% of at least 30 nonzero pairs covering at least 90% of all pairs. Cohort, contrast, identifiers and effect definitions must be compatible. The paper uses FDR < 0.05. Raw P and magnitude differences are reported separately.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Both effect routes pass for the registered fasting contrast. The different discovery sets, incomplete identifier and animal mapping, and unverified journal-file identity limit full reproduction.

additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: 16-hour fasted minus ad libitum fed male wild-type hypothalamus at ZT16 in both fits. The author coefficient retains its original sign.
additionalComparisonSpec.note: Uses all 20,423 rows of the preprint FastingInWT sheet, including four unjoinable date cells with worksheet-row identifiers. Source-only, one-to-one reconciliation recovers 20 other date labels. The 16,906 shared pairs have finite coefficients and adjusted P. Both effect routes pass. FDR < 0.05 yields 929 author and 793 local calls overall, with 789 shared. Missing author adjusted P remains unassessed.
additionalComparisonSpec.resultScope: Full preprint result table for the registered wild-type ZT16 fasting contrast.
